method: Conservative 2D screen of existing tracks/vias/pad bounding boxes; excludes zones. Existing switch drills preserved. Every case considered at four rotations; choose contact net assignment minimizing component clashes, sites, then item count. No board mutation. Not DRC or manufacturing validation.
assumptions: Alternate electrical copper pads provisionally 2.4 mm diameter plus 0.2 mm clearance
NPTH copper clearance screened at 0.25 mm
0.25 mm hole-to-hole web used as a study threshold only; confirm actual fabrication rules
Gateron 2.0 1.5 mm solder drills provisional; original drawing connector holes differ
A rotation changes switch LED-window orientation and can change latch fit; not an approved mechanical solution
